user.title: Add Pico(s)
user.description: Select one or more Pico remotes to link as a single entry — pick several when they should all behave identically (e.g. multiple remotes for the same stairway light); their entities, timing, and behavior are configured once and shared. Only unconfigured Lutron Pico devices are listed, and all selected must be the same type — its type is detected automatically from the hardware, so there's nothing else to pick here.

entities.title: What do these Picos control?
entities.description: Fill in the entities for the ONE domain this entry's Pico(s) control, and leave the rest empty. If you selected more than one Pico, they all share this configuration.

buttons.title: Scene buttons
buttons.description: Assign one or more actions to each button. A button left empty does nothing when pressed. At least one button must be configured.

error.single_domain_required: Fill in exactly one of the fields above — the one domain this Pico controls — and leave the rest empty.
error.buttons_required: Configure at least one button with actions.
error.mixed_pico_types: Select devices of only one Pico type — the devices you picked aren't all the same type.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Lutron Pico remotes were found. Make sure the Lutron Caséta integration is set up and that the Pico isn't already configured.

devices.title: Edit Pico(s) in this entry
devices.description: Add or remove Picos from this entry. Only Picos of this entry's type ({pico_type}) that aren't claimed by another entry are offered; at least one must remain selected. The rest of this entry's configuration is shared by every Pico selected here.

entities.title: What do these Picos control?
entities.description: Fill in the entities for the ONE domain this entry's Pico(s) control, and leave the rest empty. If this entry has more than one Pico, they all share this configuration.

options.title: Options
options.description: Fine-tune timing and behavior. Applies to every Pico in this entry.

accent_light.title: Accent light
accent_light.description: Optional (P2B, 2B, and 3BRL only): pick an accent light (e.g. a ring or edge light) to enable dual-light mode. ON switches to the Lights configured above; OFF switches to this accent light. The two are never on at the same time. Leave empty to disable dual-light mode.

accent_light_appearance.title: Accent light appearance (preset {preset_number})
accent_light_appearance.description: Choose what the accent light looks like for this preset. Effect and white-temperature choices are read from the first accent light selected; pick 'No effect' to use the color (or white temperature) instead. Check 'Try it' to turn the accent light(s) on with what's filled in now, without leaving this step. Check 'Remove this preset' (shown only for a preset that already exists) to drop it instead of keeping it. Check 'Add another preset' to configure a further appearance — repeated OFF taps while the accent light is already on cycle through every preset you add, in order.

light_presets.title: Light presets (preset {preset_number})
light_presets.description: Optional, 3BRL only, and only when not using an accent light (see the previous step). Check 'Cycle light appearance from STOP' to have STOP switch this Pico's light(s) through one or more saved appearances every press, instead of doing nothing — or its STOP actions on the next step, since a Pico can use one or the other, not both. Effect and white-temperature choices are read from the first configured light. Check 'Try it' to apply what's filled in now without leaving this step. Check 'Remove this preset' (shown only for a preset that already exists) to drop it. Check 'Add another preset' to configure a further appearance — STOP wraps back to the first after the last.

custom_actions.title: Custom actions
custom_actions.description: All optional. 'STOP actions' run on every STOP tap, replacing the default STOP behavior for this domain — unavailable if the previous step's light-preset cycling is enabled instead. A button's hold actions run in addition to its normal press behavior once held past the hold time. A button's double-tap actions replace its normal tap on two quick taps, but only after that button's own tap is left waiting to confirm a second one didn't follow — a button can use hold OR double-tap, not both. Pick one from 'Test an action' and submit to run it immediately with what's filled in now, without leaving this step or saving.

buttons.title: Scene buttons
buttons.description: Assign one or more actions to each button. A button left empty does nothing when pressed. At least one button must be configured.

scene_hold_actions.title: Scene hold and double-tap actions
scene_hold_actions.description: All optional. A button's hold actions run in addition to its scene action once held past the hold time. A button's double-tap actions replace its scene action on two quick taps, but only after that button's own tap is left waiting to confirm a second one didn't follow — a button can use hold OR double-tap, not both. Pick one from 'Test an action' and submit to run it immediately with what's filled in now, without leaving this step or saving.

error.single_domain_required: Fill in exactly one of the fields above — the one domain this Pico controls — and leave the rest empty.
error.buttons_required: Configure at least one button with actions.
error.at_least_one_device_required: Select at least one Pico to keep in this entry.
error.hold_and_double_tap_conflict: A button can use hold actions or double-tap actions, not both — remove one before continuing.
error.test_action_failed: The test action failed to run. Check the log for details; your other entries here were kept.
error.accent_light_overlap: An accent light can't also be one of the lights configured above — pick a different accent light, or remove it from the Lights step.
error.middle_button_light_presets_conflict: STOP actions can't be combined with the light-preset cycling configured on the previous step — clear one or the other before continuing.

pico_type_mismatch.title: Pico hardware type mismatch
pico_type_mismatch.description: Device `{device_id}` is configured in Pico Link as a `{configured_type}`, but {reason}. Its button events are being ignored until this is resolved. Confirm the Pico's type in its Pico Link entry, or remove and re-add it if the physical device changed.

pico_removed.title: Pico removed from the Lutron bridge
pico_removed.description: "{title}" in Pico Link references device `{device_id}`, which no longer exists in Home Assistant's device registry — it may have been removed or re-paired on the Lutron bridge. Its button presses will do nothing until this is resolved. Edit or remove this Pico Link entry to match your current hardware.

pico_entity_missing.title: Pico Link entity no longer exists
pico_entity_missing.description: "{title}" in Pico Link references {entities}, which no longer exist in Home Assistant's entity registry — they may have been deleted or renamed. Button presses that target them will do nothing until this is resolved. Edit this Pico Link entry to point at the correct entities.
